{{Quote|I need a place to do my research, but I'm a bit short of funding. Then I found this place, only it's overrun with all these creatures. Can you rid the bunker of some of them for me?|[[Lejo Daramus]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:VB" />}}
The '''Abandoned Bunker''' was a bunker located in the [[Kor Vella mesa]], near the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]], on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==History==
The building was abandoned by the time of [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an independent spacer working for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope|Cope]] visited the bunker while investigating an assassination attempt on [[Deel Draav]], the mayor of Kor Vella. The spacer found evidence that seemed to prove that his political opponent [[Hershel Sheridan]] had been behind the assassination attempt.<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /> The spacer also met the scientist [[Lejo Daramus]] at the entrance of the bunker. Daramus paid the spacer to rid the place of fiendish [[durni]]s in order to use the place to conduct his research.<ref name="SWG:VB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Abandoned Bunker appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Abandoned Bunker was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
